__NOTOC__ Stygian Abductors are Mawsworn kyrian located in the Maw. Players who have reached rank four of Eye of the Jailer will have these units spawn randomly, without warning. Without the Soul-Stabilizing Talisman from Ve'nari, they will prove rather difficult to fight off.

Sturdy Horseshoes are found in Discarded Horseshoes on the roads between Darkhaven and the Endmire in Revendreth. Supply Dead Blanchy with four on the third day of interacting with her to advance progress on learning the Blanchy's Reins mount.
Stygian Hammer drops from Stygian Runesmiths in Zovaal's Cauldron in the Maw.
The Strong Heart is hanging on a chain in the Body Banks in Maldraxxus, next to the Kind Heart and Ruthless Heart.
Stygian Souls are souls flowing through Gorgoa: River of Souls in the Maw in great numbers.
Stygian Shardworms are gyreworms located in the Beastwarrens in the Maw.
Stygian Shardlings are unbound earth elementals located in the Beastwarrens in the Maw.
__NOTOC__ Stygian Runesmiths are Maw guards located in Zovaal's Cauldron in the Maw.
Stygian Remnants are shades located throughout the Beastwarrens in the Maw.
Stygian Monoliths are death elementals located in Perdition Hold in the Maw.

Stygia Dowser is bought from Ve'nari in the Maw for 1,500 Stygia for players at an (exalted) standing with her. It is part of the Bound Shadehound acquisition. The item allows the player to see Stygia Nexus on the minimap and loot Stygia Dust and Stygia Sliver. There is also a puzzle hinted at by Stygia Residue at the Altar of Domination.

]] Stygia Dust is looted from Stygia Nexuses in the Maw by using the Stygia Dowser, one step of many to acquire the Bound Shadehound. Combine 10 Dust and 10 Stygia Sliver to create a Stygia Bar at the Soulsteel Anvil atop Altar of Domination in Perdition Hold. Players will need 20 bars to craft the Armored Husk (item), so 200 each of dust and slivers will be required.

]] Stygia Sliver is looted from Stygia Nexuses in the Maw by using the Stygia Dowser, one step of many to acquire the Bound Shadehound. Combine 10 Slivers and 10 Stygia Dust to create a Stygia Bar at the Soulsteel Anvil atop Altar of Domination in Perdition Hold. Players will need 20 bars to craft the Armored Husk (item), so 200 each of dust and slivers will be required.

]] Stygia Bar is created from 10 Stygia Dust and 10 Stygia Sliver at the Soulsteel Anvil on the top of the Altar of Domination in the Maw. After crafting 20 bars, use the anvil again and combine them with Soulforger's Tools to create an Armored Husk (item), part of the process of creating the Bound Shadehound.

__NOTOC__ Stygian Bombarders are death elementals located at the Vault of Secrets in Korthia.
The Stygian Chains are located near the Eye of the Jailer in the Sanctum of Domination. They can be used to cross the gap.
Stygian Steel Nuggets are sold by Ve'nari for 300x Stygia at her refuge in the Maw for players with a ... or higher standing with her.
Stygian Steel Settings are sold by Ve'nari for 500x Stygia at her refuge in the Maw for players with a ... or higher standing with her.
__NOTOC__ Stygian Punishers are death elementals located at Desmotaeron in the Maw. One is found guarding the Helsworn Chest.
Stygian Stonecrusher is a rare death elemental located at the Vault of Secrets in Korthia. The stonecrusher is the boss of the "No Stoneborn Left Behind" vignette, required for Conquering Korthia.

Stygian Embers can be exchanged for Shards of Domination with Bonesmith Heirmir at Keeper's Respite in Korthia. Find them on the bosses in the Sanctum of Domination, and as a one-time quest reward from In Need of Assistance.
Stygic Cluster is found inside the Helsworn Chest at in Desmotaeron of the Maw.
The Stygian Crystal Studded Legguards drop from the Stygian Stonecrusher at the Vault of Secrets in Korthia.
The Stygia-Etched Decapitator drops from Morguliax in the Crucible of the Damned in the Maw.
The Stygian Chestcage drops from Darithis the Bleak in the northern end of Echoing Caverns in the Maw.
Stuffans is a dredger located at the Night Market in Revendreth.
Strongarm Privates are humans located at the Strongarm Airstrip in the Jade Forest. After the Horde took the base, they are found dead.
__NOTOC__ Strongarm Medics are draenei, gnomes, worgen, and dwarves located in the Strongarm Airstrip in the Jade Forest. After the Horde took the base, they are found dead.
Strongarm Lieutenants are humans located in the Strongarm Airstrip in the Jade Forest. After the Horde took the base, they are found dead.
__NOTOC__ Strongarm Laborers are humans located at the Strongarm Airstrip in the Jade Forest. After the Horde took the base, they are found dead.
Stygian Lance of Passage is dropped by the Eye of the Jailer in the Sanctum of Domination.
The Stygian Forge is a fiery workshop in the lower Sanctum of Domination that connects the Eye's Overlook in the south to the central spire and the River of Souls.
The Stygian Chain Greaves drop from Mor'geth at Helgarde Keep in The Maw.
The Stygian Pain Borer drops from Manifestation of Pain in The Maw.

FunctionContainer objects wrap a single Lua function to be executed later as a callback from native APIs. Function containers are exposed to the scripting environment as handles with a set of predefined methods to control execution of the callback. It is permitted to store additional user-defined fields on function containers, so long as they do not conflict with any of the predefined methods.

Suicide Kings is a loot distribution system for guild raiding. Suicide Kings was designed to be a system that distributes loot in a decently fair manner, and nothing else. If you choose SK as your loot system, that means you are going to have to find some other way to get players to perform well and show up when no loot drops. This emphasizes the point that SK works better in casual and friendly environments where people show up to play first and foremost, and loot is but a happy consequence. If loot is the main (or only!) reason people show up, SK is not the right system for you.

The World of Warcraft subscription usually refers to automatic monthly periods to access World of Warcraft. Subscribing from the Blizzard Shop can be done in increments of 30 days, 3 months, or 6 months. However, the payments will go through automatically instead of having to do it manually like game time. Having a subscription or game time allows access to the retail servers up to the last expansion from the current one, Classic Era, and the current Classic expansion.
